validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and independently corroborated. This row is Package 10 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS III), the '56-inch EWJZG-1 pipeline from Sector I STS-2 to Sector II STS-1'. Two project-tracking databases independent of GEM document this exact segment: Oil & Gas News (OGN) Article 47234 explicitly states '56-inch EWJZG-1 ... from Sector I STS 2 to Sector II STS 1, spanning a distance of 310 km ... Package 10', and DMS Projects hosts a dedicated entry titled 'Package 10 - Sector I STS 2 to Sector II STS 1 Pipeline (EWJZG-1)' (PRJ00030611). The EPC contractor SICIM's own site confirms it executes 'packages 10 and 14' of the MGS expansion (with Nesma & Partners). Not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- a dry-gas transmission trunk segment of the Master Gas System (the kingdom's main gas transport network), construction commenced Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028; PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are right. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate. The 'EWJZG-1' line is split into three consecutive GEM rows by station-to-station segment, each a distinct package with a distinct length: P6729 = BGCS-10->STS-2 (458 km, Package 9), P6730 = STS-2->STS-1 (310 km, Package 10), P6731 = STS-1->Shoqaiq/Shuqaiq (462 km, Package 11). Distinct endpoints and lengths, so P6730 is its own physical segment, not a relabel of P6729/P6731. SPEC: Length 310 km AGREES with OGN/DMS (both give 310 km for Package 10); Diameter 56 in AGREES (both say 56-inch); these two independent sources match the GEM values exactly. Status=construction and StartYear1=2028 are consistent with the documented Q2-2024 start / Q4-2028 completion. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator Saudi Aramco confirmed by all sources. Caveat: per-segment 310 km is from project-tracker databases (OGN, DMS) rather than an Aramco primary disclosure -- the Aramco/MEED releases give the program-level totals (15 LSTK contracts, ~4,150 km total, +3.2 bscfd), not this segment's km; treat 310 km as high-confidence per OGN+DMS agreement but flag that the figure is tracker-sourced. No capacity is published at segment level (left blank, correct).

summary: P6730 confirmed (caveat): real, gas transmission, NOT a duplicate -- it is MGS III Phase-3 Package 10 (EWJZG-1, STS-2->STS-1); length 310 km and diameter 56 in both agree with two independent trackers (OGN, DMS); 310 km is tracker-sourced not Aramco-primary.
